about: An index of the CEC's 2026 poll filings as read by third parties, kept until the filings are fetched from a GitHub runner (pipeline/fetchers/poll_filings.py) and read here: every value is a third party's reading of the PDF at 'pdf', verified: false. Party names mapped to polls_2026.json ids by build_poll_filings.party_id.
filing_rule: https://www.bhol.co.il/news/1734638 (CEC director-general's letter, 29.7.2026: every poll published from 90 days before the election is filed within 96 hours and posted as sent)

or523.gives: the collector's index (item, survey number, editor, outlet, CEC dates and notes, fieldwork dates) and each filing's seat table with the shares of the lists that won seats; filings without a national seat table listed as excluded with the reason

amitlev.gives: for the filings it matched to a poll: respondents, invited, response rate, sampling error, method fields and the shares of all lists (pdf-parse; its parser validated on the Midgam/Lazar, Kantar and Maagar Mochot templates)

isaranga.gives: respondents (sample_size, 'the number of respondents, not the initial sample' by its .claude/skills/add-poll/SKILL.md) for the filings it transcribed; its shares are normalised to 100%, not used

filings.excluded: seat column incomplete - ישר listed at 12.7% with no seats
